title: Add task hybrid semantic search default-on and admin toggle
description:
Problem: task query behavior was lexical-only, which reduced recall for reordered or loosely phrased user queries and made task discovery weaker than memory hybrid semantic search flows.

Desired outcome: task list query uses hybrid lexical+semantic ranking with an explicit configuration switch that defaults to on.

Scope:
- In scope: task search ranking updates, default-on configuration in MemorySmith options/appsettings, admin settings toggle, and regression tests proving reordered query recall.
- Out of scope: ONNX embedding model integration for tasks.

Acceptance criteria:
- Task query API returns relevant items for reordered/semantically similar phrasing when hybrid toggle is enabled.
- `MemorySmith:TaskSearch:HybridSemanticEnabled` exists and defaults to true.
- Admin settings exposes the hybrid task search toggle.

Validation:
- Contract tests validate reordered query recall and overall task API behavior remains green.
- Focused test run includes AppApiContractTests with all passing.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created and completed in phase 1 after implementing hybrid lexical+semantic ranking for task queries with default-on configuration and admin toggle.
